firestore_interaction: none — no reads, no writes, no probes (Firestore daily quota exceeded at time of this run)
method: Local code/repo inspection (App.js, engine/) plus external research against official StatCan WDS API and open.canada.ca CKAN API only. No Firestore access of any kind.

findings: The federal Canada page already exists and renders: 'Canadian Federal Government' hub (src/App.js, headings/buttons around lines 13006-13138, 28820), with an 'Explore Federal' entry point from the Canada country card.

A federal economic/social stats page already exists via the shared renderGovernmentStatsPage() component (renderAnalytics(), src/App.js:32706), covering economic/safety/health/housing/education/social sections — currently populated with hardcoded demo values (e.g. unemployment '6.3%', period 'Jan-Jun 2024'), each with a firestoreKey (e.g. 'unemploymentRate') that CAN be live-overlaid from Firestore if a matching document exists.

A federal contracts page already exists and is ALREADY wired to Firestore: renderContracts() (src/App.js:32752) reads liveContracts.CA, populated from the 'government_contracts' collection filtered by jurisdiction=='CA' (src/App.js:6429). Fields expected per contract doc: contractor_name, department, value, purpose, date (used directly in the render code).

A 'National fiscal snapshot' (revenue/spending/deficit/debt) block already exists, reading the 'government_stats' collection filtered by country=='CA' (fetchMacroGovernmentStats(), src/App.js:18666) — a broader macro-fiscal overlay, separate from the per-stat 'social_stats' overlay described above.

No engine script in this repo currently writes to 'social_stats', 'government_stats', or 'government_contracts' for country='CA' — confirmed via repo-wide search. These are existing, tested UI read-paths waiting for real data; nothing needs to be built or changed in the UI to make new federal data visible once written.
section_1_federal_profile_overview.conclusion: No UI code changes are needed to surface new federal datasets — the app already has working read-paths for federal unemployment/social stats (social_stats), federal fiscal macro data (government_stats), and federal contracts (government_contracts). Writing correctly-shaped documents to these existing collections is sufficient.

section_2_federal_economic_social_data.coordinate: 1.7.1.1.1.1.0.0.0.0 (Canada; Unemployment rate; Total-Gender; 15+; Estimate; Seasonally adjusted) — the same coordinate already used throughout this project as the 'CA Average' national comparator for every province
section_2_federal_economic_social_data.licence: Statistics Canada Open Licence (compatible with reuse; same terms already relied on for all provincial/territorial unemployment datasets)
section_2_federal_economic_social_data.fetch_method: statcanProvincialUnemployment(STATCAN_CA_COORD, STATCAN_CA_COORD, 'Canada', 'Canada', N) via the fixed StatCan WDS reliability helper (statcanWdsPostJson) — confirmed working with NO ECONNRESET
section_2_federal_economic_social_data.implementation_note: The existing statcanProvincialUnemployment() signature takes a separate jurisdiction and national-comparator coordinate; for the federal/Canada case these are identical, producing a redundant 'national_average' field equal to the jurisdiction value. A small dedicated buildFederalEconomic() wrapper (not built in this dry-run) would call statcanUnemploymentMonthlyFromProduct() directly and omit the redundant comparator field, but the existing function already works correctly as a stopgap.

proposed_firestore_targets.option: A (recommended — matches existing UI with zero UI changes)
proposed_firestore_targets.doc_shape: one doc per (country, statName) pair, e.g. { country: 'CA', statName: 'unemploymentRate', value: '6.4%', source: 'Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey', sourceUrl: '...', updated: 'Aug 2026', trend: [6.5,6.6,...,6.4], last_updated: <ISO> }
proposed_firestore_targets.note: This is the exact collection/shape already read by renderGovernmentStatsPage()'s liveStats overlay (govStatsData[country][statName]) — writing here makes the existing hardcoded demo value get replaced by live data automatically, no UI change needed.

proposed_firestore_targets.option: B (consistent with provincial pattern, but NOT currently read by any federal UI)
proposed_firestore_targets.note: Reuses the exact same mergeTransparencyDoc()/buildUnemploymentFirestoreFields() pipeline already used for every province — simplest to implement from the engine side, but would require confirming (or adding) a UI read-path for a country-level doc in this collection, since today's federal page reads social_stats/government_stats instead.

section_2_federal_economic_social_data.recommended_option: A — reuses existing UI with zero UI changes, per the 'do not modify UI unless absolutely necessary' rule.
section_2_federal_economic_social_data.safe_to_write_later: YES — fetch confirmed working via the reliability helper with no ECONNRESET; only blocked by the current Firestore quota exhaustion. A small mapping/write script (fields above) would need to be created before writing.

section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.dataset_name: Proactive Publication - Contracts (Government of Canada, all federal entities)
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.publisher: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (consolidates all federal reporting entities)
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.reporting_period: Continuous, quarterly reporting cycle; verified records with contract dates and forward-dated contract periods into 2026-2027
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.dry_run_verification: Queried live via CKAN datastore_search API (no scraping, no PDF): confirmed 1,313,551 total records; most recent records include contract_date 2026-12-01 and reporting_period '2026-2027-Q1', confirming currency.
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.label_reasoning: The source is officially and narrowly titled 'Contracts' (all federal contracts over $10,000) — not a mix of grants/transfers, so 'Contracts' is accurate without forcing a broader or narrower label.

proposed_firestore_target.note: This collection and its exact doc schema (contractor_name, department, value, purpose, date) ALREADY EXIST and are already read live by the federal Contracts UI (renderContracts(), src/App.js:32752) filtered by jurisdiction=='CA'. No new collection or UI needed.

warnings: 1,313,551 total records is far larger than any provincial dataset handled so far (provinces use a MAX_RECORDS=100 top-N pattern). Storing all records is neither necessary nor practical in Firestore. A bounded selection strategy (e.g. top N most recent and/or highest-value contracts, or a rolling most-recent-fiscal-year window) needs a product decision before a write script is built — this dry-run does not propose a specific N.
Field 'contract_value' can be null/blank for some records (amendments-only rows) — a filter for non-null values would be needed, same pattern as provincial grants modules.
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.safe_to_write_later: YES, once (a) Firestore quota clears and (b) a reviewer confirms the record-selection scope (how many / which subset of 1.3M+ records to store).

section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.dataset_name: Proactive Disclosure - Grants and Contributions (Government of Canada, all federal entities subject to the Policy on Transfer Payments)
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.publisher: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat (consolidates all federal institutions subject to the Policy on Transfer Payments)
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.reporting_period: Continuous; verified records with agreement start dates into 2027
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.dry_run_verification: Queried live via CKAN datastore_search API: confirmed 1,325,817 total records; most recent agreement_start_date values include 2027-01-01 and 2026-12-15, confirming currency. Real named recipients (e.g. Carleton University, The Nature Conservancy of Canada) with real dollar values confirmed in sample.
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.label_reasoning: The source is officially and specifically titled 'Grants and Contributions' — a distinct federal disclosure regime from Contracts (different legal authority: Policy on Transfer Payments vs. procurement policy). Using 'Grants and Contributions' rather than a generic 'Grants' or 'Public Payments' matches the source exactly and avoids conflating it with the Contracts dataset above.

proposed_firestore_target.collection: not yet established for federal — no existing UI reads a federal grants collection today
options: New collection mirroring 'government_contracts' (e.g. 'government_grants_and_contributions', jurisdiction: 'CA') — would need a new UI section built (contrary to 'no UI changes unless necessary'; flagged as a bigger decision)

Reuse 'subnational_grants' collection with doc_id 'CA' (country-level), matching the provincial pattern used throughout this project — would ALSO need a UI read-path added, since the federal page currently has no 'Grants and Contributions' section at all
proposed_firestore_target.note: Unlike CV-DATA-CA-FED-003A (Contracts), there is no existing federal UI section for grants/contributions today. Writing this dataset would require either new UI work or an explicit reviewer decision to defer the UI and only stage the data. Recommend treating this as a separate, later decision from the Contracts dataset above.

warnings: Same record-count/selection-scope issue as Contracts (1,325,817 total records) — needs the same kind of bounded top-N or windowed selection decision.

No existing UI section renders federal grants/contributions today, unlike Contracts — writing this data would not be visible anywhere without additional UI work, which this task is scoped to avoid unless the reviewer decides otherwise.
section_3_federal_payments_grants_spendi.safe_to_write_later: CONDITIONAL — data is confirmed current, comprehensive, and machine-readable, and is safe to write into Firestore once quota clears and a record-selection scope is set, BUT it will not be visible in the app until a UI decision is made (new section, or defer).

section_4_federal_charities_tax_exempt.recommendation: SKIP a dedicated federal/all-Canada aggregate charities view
reasoning: The CRA Charities Registry is already a federal (national) source, and it is already used — filtered by province — for every province/territory's Tax Exempt/Charities modal (subnational_tax_exempt_entities/CA-XX, 12 of 13 jurisdictions written so far).

An undifferentiated all-Canada aggregate view would contain roughly 170,000+ organizations (per the source's own scale, consistent with CRA's published total charity count) — far beyond any reasonable top-N display, and would provide no additional insight beyond what users can already get by browsing per-province.

Building a genuinely useful federal charities view (e.g. searchable/filterable across all provinces) would require new UI/search infrastructure, which this task is scoped to avoid unless absolutely necessary.
No existing UI section expects or reads a federal-level charities collection today.
section_4_federal_charities_tax_exempt.source_reference: Same CRA Charities Registry / open.canada.ca CKAN package (51c68b86-33f0-46fe-9b51-0a786d0088f5) already used for every province, confirmed still current (identification resource last modified 2026-01-23).
section_4_federal_charities_tax_exempt.safe_to_write_later: N/A — not recommended for write; no dataset proposed.
